option.tupenter.reset_on_new_session: Clear Resend History on New Session
tooltip.tupenter.reset_on_new_session: If enabled, your resend history is automatically cleared when you join a world or server.
tooltip.tupenter.rapid_resend_delay: How many ticks the key must be held before rapid-fire starts. Only applies in Press & Hold mode.
tooltip.tupenter.resend_filter: Controls which types of sent messages are recorded and replayed. Note: Changing this setting will clear your current history.
tooltip.tupenter.resend_mode: Press & Hold: Resend fires while the key is held down. Toggle: Resend fires continuously until the key is pressed again. Off: Disables the resend key.
tooltip.tupenter.message_delay: Ticks to wait between sending each individual message in a batch. Set to 0 for no delay.
tooltip.tupenter.suppress_feedback:
Controls whether command output messages are hidden in your chat while Tupenter is firing.
- Off: Never suppress.
- On: Always suppress while firing.
- Dynamic: Only suppress in Toggle mode, not in Press & Hold. Useful if you want feedback when testing (hold), but silence when running hands-free (toggled on).
Note: suppression is client-side only — the server still processes commands normally.
tooltip.tupenter.pause_tracking: If enabled, newly sent messages will NOT update the resend queue while Tupenter is toggled on. Useful to avoid accidentally changing what is being spammed.
tooltip.tupenter.history_depth: How many of your most recent messages Tupenter tracks as a batch. If above 1, Tupenter will remember the last X messages and resend all of them together each cycle.
tooltip.tupenter.resend_delay: Delay between each full batch of messages.
tooltip.tupenter.batch_mode:
Controls behavior when stopping mid-batch:
- Pause: Resume next time.
- Finish: Complete current batch.
- Interrupt: Stop and reset.
(Batches always complete if Message Delay is 0)
tooltip.tupenter.resend_amount: Tupenter will fire off X times in a single tick. Can cause lag or disconnects with higher values.
tooltip.tupenter.resend_order: Order in which history items in a batch are resent.
tooltip.tupenter.import_history: Copies your current session history into the preset messages list. WARNING: This will reload the screen and discard other unsaved changes!
tooltip.tupenter.permanent_messages: The list of messages or commands Tupenter will send when 'What to Resend' is set to Preset Messages.
message.tupenter.import_confirm: This will reload the screen and discard any other unsaved changes. Are you sure?
